SNLValeur.meta_desc: The value of the SNL token is based on scarcity, growing demand and utility within the SUNALA ecosystem. Understand the economic fundamentals of SNL.
SNLValeur.og_desc: Scarcity, demand and utility: why the SUNALA SNL token has value and how it evolves.
SNLValeur.hero_subtitle: It's not magic. It's economics. Here are the mechanisms that structurally support the $SNL value.
SNLValeur.mech1_desc: A portion of the real revenues generated by partner farms is used to buy back $SNL on the market and destroy it. Fewer tokens in circulation = each remaining token is worth more.
SNLValeur.mech2_desc: Upgrading plots and Farm Nodes requires burning $SNL. The more the platform is used, the more tokens are automatically destroyed. Activity reduces supply.
SNLValeur.mech3_desc: 1 billion $SNL maximum. Not one more. Ever. With growing demand and a fixed supply (shrinking with burns), price pressure can only increase.
SNLValeur.mech4_desc: The $SNL is not just a speculative token. It is backed by real assets, land, harvests, livestock. The value of these African assets is real and growing.
SNLValeur.supply_burns: Burns progressively reduce the circulating supply
SNLValeur.timeline_subtitle: Here is exactly how you go from today's free points to a real crypto asset tomorrow.
SNLValeur.step1_desc: Daily login, missions, partners, every action gives you points. These points are not yet $SNL but they represent your future allocation at launch.
SNLValeur.step1_badge: This is the phase you're currently in
SNLValeur.step2_desc: At the official token launch, every point you have accumulated automatically converts to real $SNL. The rate is fixed: 1,000 points = 1 $SNL. Without paying anything extra.
SNLValeur.step3_desc: SUNALA is listed on PancakeSwap and other DEXs. Your $SNL now has a dollar value. You can hold it, sell it, or use it within the SUNALA ecosystem.
SNLValeur.step3_badge: You can hold, sell or invest
SNLValeur.step4_desc: Real partner farms in Africa are tokenized. You use your $SNL to invest directly. Real agricultural profits come back to you proportionally.
SNLValeur.step4_badge: Your token, real African agricultural assets
SNLValeur.cta_subtitle: Points accumulate for free. Launch is approaching. Early members will always be ahead of the rest.

SNLFaq.q1: Can I lose money with SUNALA?
SNLFaq.a1: During the pre-launch phase: no. Accumulating points is completely free. You're not investing money, just time. After launch, like any cryptocurrency, the value of $SNL may fluctuate. But since the points are free, you risk nothing before launch.
SNLFaq.q2: What is the difference between points and $SNL?
SNLFaq.a2: Points are credit units you accumulate during the pre-launch phase. At the official token launch in Q2 2026, they automatically convert to real $SNL at the fixed rate of 1,000 points = 1 $SNL. Before launch, points have no monetary value, they represent your future allocation.
SNLFaq.q3: Why is $SNL worth more than a simple memecoin?
SNLFaq.a3: Unlike useless memecoins, $SNL is backed by real agricultural assets in Africa. It serves as the single currency in the SUNALA ecosystem, is burned during upgrades (reducing supply), and is governed by the community through the DAO. Its supply is capped at 1 billion and structurally decreases over time.
SNLFaq.a4: Your $SNL will be available for sale upon listing on DEXs, planned for Q3 2026. Until then, you accumulate pre-launch points that convert to real $SNL at the official token launch in Q2 2026. You can then hold, sell, or reinvest in the ecosystem.
SNLFaq.a5: The $SNL is deployed on BNB Chain, a public and verifiable blockchain. All contracts are audited and transactions are transparent and traceable. The total supply is written into the contract code and cannot be changed, not even by the SUNALA team.
SNLFaq.q6: Why start now and not after launch?
SNLFaq.a6: The first members accumulate points for the longest period before launch. The earlier you start, the more points you accumulate, and the more $SNL you receive at launch. After launch, $SNL will need to be purchased with real money. Today, it's 100% free.

SNLMain.meta_desc: Everything about the SUNALA SNL token: its utility, value, uses in the ecosystem and how to accumulate it for free every day.
SNLMain.og_desc: What is $SNL? Discover SUNALA's native token, its utility and how to accumulate it for free.
SNLMain.hero_p1: The $SNL is not just another cryptocurrency.
SNLMain.hero_p2: It is the entry key to a real agricultural ecosystem, linking Africa to the entire world through blockchain.
SNLMain.resume_p1: The $SNL token (SUNALA Token) is a utility cryptocurrency deployed on the BNB Chain blockchain. Unlike memecoins with no real value, $SNL is directly linked to physical agricultural assets in Africa.
SNLMain.resume_p2: Think of it as an internal currency of an entire ecosystem, like V-Bucks in Fortnite, but with value anchored in the real world. Except instead of buying skins, you invest in real African farms.
SNLMain.resume_p3: Supply capped at 1 billion. Not one more token will ever be created. Scarcity is mathematically guaranteed.
SNLMain.why1_desc: Without $SNL, no access to plots, Farm Nodes or agricultural NFTs. It's the mandatory entry ticket.
SNLMain.why2_desc: Every login, mission and referral earns you $SNL. Activity is directly rewarded.
SNLMain.why3_desc: The $SNL is the only currency accepted to invest in real tokenized African agricultural land.

SNLUtilite.meta_desc: The SNL token is the access key to the SUNALA ecosystem. Understand its role, functions and why it is at the heart of the platform.
SNLUtilite.og_desc: The SNL is the key to the SUNALA ecosystem. Discover its utility and central role in the platform.
SNLUtilite.hero_subtitle_1: One token. Six ways to use it.
SNLUtilite.hero_subtitle_2: Each use creates value for you and for the ecosystem.
SNLUtilite.util1_desc: Without $SNL, no access to virtual plots, Farm Nodes, agricultural NFTs or advanced features. It's the mandatory entry ticket to participate in SUNALA.
SNLUtilite.util1_example: Want to buy a virtual corn plot? You pay in $SNL. Want to activate a Farm Node? You pay in $SNL.
SNLUtilite.util2_desc: Every action in SUNALA earns you $SNL. Daily login, missions, developing your virtual farm, optimized Farm Nodes, everything is rewarded in $SNL.
SNLUtilite.util2_example: Your virtual rice plot generates daily $SNL returns based on its simulated agricultural performance.
SNLUtilite.util3_desc: This is the most powerful utility. $SNL is the ONLY currency accepted to buy and invest in real tokenized African agricultural land. Virtual to Real.
SNLUtilite.util3_example: A poultry farm in Benin is tokenized. To invest in it, you use $SNL. The real farm profits come back to you in $SNL.
SNLUtilite.util4_desc: Upgrading your virtual farm, leveling up your plots, accessing higher levels, all done by burning $SNL. This mechanism reduces circulating supply and supports the price.
SNLUtilite.util4_example: Upgrading your plot from Bronze to Silver requires burning 500 $SNL. These tokens are permanently destroyed, they can no longer be sold.
SNLUtilite.util5_desc: $SNL holders can vote on important project decisions: which partner farm to integrate, how to allocate resources, what new features to develop.
SNLUtilite.util5_example: "Do we open a partner farm in Senegal or Ivory Coast?", It's the $SNL holders who vote and decide.
SNLUtilite.util6_desc: Like any serious cryptocurrency, $SNL can be bought, sold and traded on DEXs and CEXs. Its value increases with project adoption and burn mechanisms.
SNLUtilite.util6_example: You accumulate $SNL via pre-launch points. At listing on PancakeSwap, their value is determined by the market. Your points become a real asset.

SNLUsage.meta_desc: Discover all the concrete uses of the SNL token on SUNALA: payments, access to training, referral rewards and much more.
SNLUsage.og_desc: What is SNL used for? Payments, training, referrals, all the use cases of the SUNALA token.
SNLUsage.hero_subtitle: Concrete cases of members accumulating $SNL, and what they do with it.
SNLUsage.s1_title: Amadou logs in every morning from his phone in Benin
SNLUsage.s1_p: Amadou spends 30 seconds on SUNALA every morning to claim his points. He has also invited 5 active partners into his network. In 6 months of consistency, he accumulates nearly 21,000 points. At launch, he receives 21 $SNL without spending a cent. He holds or sells them depending on the market price.
SNLUsage.s2_title: Marie signs up today among the first 1,000 members
SNLUsage.s2_p: Marie signs up right now, when the community is still small. She accumulates points for 12 months before launch. At token launch, she has 45,000 points or 45 $SNL. The $SNL price at listing is $0.10, her 45 $SNL are worth $4.50. If the price rises to $1 (realistic target according to the roadmap), her 45 $SNL are worth $45. An investment in time, not money.
SNLUsage.s3_title: Kofi owns a poultry farm in Ghana and tokenizes it on SUNALA
SNLUsage.s3_p: Kofi joins SUNALA as an agricultural partner. His farm of 500 chickens is tokenized, its value is represented in $SNL. Investors from around the world can now buy shares of his farm with $SNL. Kofi receives immediate funding. Investors receive a share of profits with each sales cycle.

About.meta_desc: The history, mission, and values behind SUNALA — a concrete bridge between blockchain and African agriculture.
About.hero_title: A concrete bridge between blockchain and African agriculture
About.hero_subtitle: The story behind SUNALA, our mission, and the values that guide us every day.
About.history_p1: Africa holds more than 60% of the world's unexploited arable land, yet its farmers remain among the least financed in the world.
About.history_p2: While global finance is digitalising at full speed, millions of African producers continue to work without access to credit, without international visibility, and without the digital tools that could transform their activity.
About.history_p3: SUNALA is our answer to this observation: a concrete bridge between blockchain and real African agriculture.
About.mission_title: We are building a complete ecosystem where:
About.mission_1: Every user, wherever they are in the world, can participate in the African agricultural economy.
About.mission_2: Every virtual plot developed on SUNALA is connected to a real agricultural project.
About.mission_3: Every $SNL token accumulated represents a value anchored in concrete production.
About.mission_4: Every partner farmer gains access to financing they could never have obtained otherwise.
About.founder_title: A vision born on the ground
About.founder_p1: SUNALA was founded by a Beninese entrepreneur convinced that blockchain technology can become a concrete tool of economic empowerment for Africa — not just an instrument of speculation.
About.founder_p2: With direct knowledge of agricultural realities in West Africa, he designed SUNALA as a project built BY Africa, FOR the world — and not the other way around.
About.founder_quote: We are not just building a cryptocurrency. We are building a bridge between two worlds that need each other.
About.value_4_desc: Every $SNL token supports a real farm.
About.cta_subtitle: Join thousands of members accumulating SNL points every day and shaping the future of African agriculture.
